shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc 'cat package.json app/page.tsx app/layout.tsx next.config.ts tsconfig.json && for f in /AGENTS.md /workspace/AGENTS.md; do if [ -f "$f" ]; then cat "$f"; fi; done'
/bin/bash -lc 'cat lib/db.js && git status --short && rg --files app lib -g AGENTS.md && true'

/bin/bash -lc "git diff --stat && git diff -- app/page.tsx app/layout.tsx && rg -n 'revalidateTag|function unstable_cache|revalidate' node_modules/next/dist/server/web/spec-extension/revalidate.d.ts node_modules/next/dist/server/web/spec-extension/unstable-cache.d.ts && cat .gitignore"
